sloka: निविष्टायां तु सेनायामुत्सुको भरतस्तदा।जगाम भ्रातरं द्रष्टुं शत्रुध्नमनुदर्शयन् ॥ २.९९.१॥
transliteration: niviṣṭāyāṁ tu senāyāmutsuko bharatastadā।jagāma bhrātaraṁ draṣṭuṁ śatrudhnamanudarśayan ॥ 2.99.1॥

translations.english: Eager to see his brother, Bharata encamped the army and set out showing the hermitage to Satrughna.
